latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: mara-texlive-pdflatex
args: module load texlive/2023 && cd "%DIR%" && export APPTAINER_BINDPATH=/mnt,/opt/apps && apptainer exec "$LATEX_SIF" pdflatex -synctex=1 -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error "%DOCFILE%"

latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: mara-texlive-bibtex
args: module load texlive/2023 && cd "%DIR%" && export APPTAINER_BINDPATH=/mnt,/opt/apps && TEXFILE="%DOCFILE%" && apptainer exec "$LATEX_SIF" bibtex "${TEXFILE%.tex}"
